title: MicroAUNet: Boundary-Enhanced Multi-scale Fusion with Knowledge Distillation for Colonoscopy Polyp Image Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2511.01143v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Early and accurate segmentation of colorectal polyps is critical for reducing colorectal cancer mortality, which has been extensively explored by academia and industry. However, current deep learning-based polyp segmentation models either compromise clinical decision-making by providing ambiguous polyp margins in segmentation outputs or rely on heavy architectures with high computational complexity, resulting in insufficient inference speeds for real-time colorectal endoscopic applications. To address this problem, we propose MicroAUNet, a lightweight attention-based segmentation network, which synergistically combines depthwise-separable dilated convolutions with a single-path, parameter-shared channel-spatial attention block to effectively strengthen multi-scale boundary features. translated_title: MicroAUNet：面向结肠镜息肉图像分割的边界增强多尺度融合与知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.01143v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：早期准确的结直肠息肉分割对于降低结直肠癌死亡率至关重要，这一点已被学术界和工业界广泛探索。然而，当前基于深度学习的分割模型要么在分割输出中提供模糊的息肉边缘，从而影响临床决策，要么依赖高计算复杂度的重型架构，导致推理速度不足，难以满足实时结直肠内镜应用的需求。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MicroAUNet，一种轻量级基于注意力的分割网络，它协同结合了深度可分离膨胀卷积与单路径、参数共享的通道-空间注意力模块，有效增强多尺度边界特征。在此基础上，引入了一种渐进式两阶段知识蒸馏方案，从高容量模型中转移语义和边界线索。
tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级注意力分割网络MicroAUNet，通过深度可分离膨胀卷积和参数共享的通道-空间注意力模块增强多尺度边界特征，并结合渐进式两阶段知识蒸馏，实现高效准确的结肠镜息肉分割。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight attention-based segmentation network MicroAUNet, which enhances multi-scale boundary features via depthwise-separable dilated convolutions and a parameter-shared channel-spatial attention block, combined with a progressive two-stage knowledge-distillation scheme for efficient and accurate colonoscopy polyp segmentation.
